headline: Site plan approved for six-story, 205-unit mixed-use building at 41 Third Street
summary: The building would replace the existing courthouse with 205 apartments, around 6,000 square feet of commercial space, and 36 parking spaces on site. The developer has requested 300 spaces in the Lower Locks Municipal Garage for tenants, and its president said first residents could arrive in July 2029. A car wash at 585 protected Boulevard was continued to December 7th, and a request to divide 675 Andover Street was withdrawn.
decisions: Allowed withdrawal without prejudice of the special permit request for 675 Andover Street, 4-0 with one abstention.
Continued the car wash review at 585 protected Boulevard to December 7th.
Approved the site plan for 41 Third Street with conditions on utilities, sidewalks, snow removal, and landscaping.
discussion: 41 Third Street site plan: Members called the plan thorough and said downtown needs market-rate housing. The applicant said some street trees may need pruning and that it would work with the planning department on any replacements.

Trash and truck access: Members asked how trash would be picked up and whether trucks could turn in the courtyard. The applicant's engineer said the dumpster locations were set so trucks could pick up carts and leave.
Historic elements: The applicant said some historic items from the courthouse, including molding, a seal, and a crest, would be reused in the new building, though not all of them.
675 Andover Street withdrawal: A resident asked whether the withdrawal was temporary. The applicant's lawyer said the request covers all matters before the planning board and the historic board.
